policy: Do not rescan screened-out candidates unless their trigger fires. New and materially updated issues are handled by delta discovery.

never.description: terminal: awarded, expired, claimant cap consumed, superseded, or permanently ineligible

route_change.description: revisit only when the required connector/write/publication/hardware/account route becomes executable

competitor_change.description: revisit only if the occupying implementation/claim is rejected or closes without award

excluded_scope.description: do not execute while current benign-only/fund-movement exclusions remain in force

low_value_or_existing_receivable_only.description: do not proactively rescan; revisit only from receivable evidence or a material maintainer update

default_for_new_screenout: assign one of never, route_change, competitor_change, maintainer_update, date_trigger, or excluded_scope at time of rejection
full_rescan: disabled unless ops/efficiency_policy.json full-rescan condition is met

triggered_rechecks.result: Live Wix distribution published; evidence sent; claim moved to viable SUBMITTED in ledger v11.

triggered_rechecks.trigger: material issue update observed in delta scan
triggered_rechecks.result: Closed/completed; requires Discord membership plus upstream PR/merge and does not clear the executable-route gate. Assigned never.

triggered_rechecks.trigger: material update surfaced in delta scan
